mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we are looking at 67 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park. We are under a Waning Gibbous moon and should expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with rain predicted before morning.

For our city updates, please note that Highway M will be closed near the future Aldi site for road work from October 6 through October 9, with traffic detoured to Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street. Additionally, absentee voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall with specific hours provided on the city website.

There is plenty to do in Verona tomorrow, including the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.

In a recent report, on September 21, officers were alerted to a retail theft of Swedish Fish at a retailer on East Verona Avenue; the individual was identified via surveillance and subsequently cited.

Today's flavor, Caramel Peanut Buttercup, is no longer available as the store is closed for the night. Please join us tomorrow starting at 10 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day, which will be Double Strawberry.
